content: RFC 8785 defines canonical JSON bytes suitable for repeatable hashing/signing. Every outer envelope should bind protocol version, opaque sync and object identifiers, author device, per-device sequence, predecessor hash, nonce, and ciphertext digest into authenticated/signature input. Persisted max counters and per-device hash chains reject replay, gaps, rollback, and equivocation; these application rules need protocol review because HPKE and AEAD do not supply them automatically.
